The '''2003 Vintage Stock Tour''' was a series of seven sealed-deck tournaments, three of ''[[Young Jedi]]'' and four of ''Star Wars'' CCG, held at seven different Vintage Stock stores in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Kansas and Missouri, one per weekend from 12 July to 30 August 2003.<ref name="pcf-1855-30308">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30308#30308 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Guy Kargl]] organized the tour and ran four of the events; [[John McDaniel]] ran one and [[Vicki Luthy]] two.<ref name="pcf-1895-30304">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30304#30304 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref>

Every event cost $10 to enter, and all of the entry fees went to the host store as store credit, which the tournament director spent on product from the store's shelves for the sealed decks.<ref name="pcf-1895-30301">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301#30301 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref> Packs sent by the [[Players Committee]] were opened at the start of each tournament and used in it.<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" /> [[Jim Colson]] of the Players Committee supplied an uncut sheet for each event, matched to the game being played,<ref name="pcf-1895-30304" /><ref name="pcf-1895-30396">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30396#30396 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Jim Colson (ShadowLeader), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref> and [[Andrew Howard]] offered ''Young Jedi'' tournament foils.<ref name="pcf-1895-30397">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30397#30397 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Andrew Howard (Yoda Killa), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Prizes ==

At each event one uncut sheet was given at random to a player who had played every game of that tournament (a bye counted as a game played), and at least two tournament foils were awarded, one to the winner and one at random; a full tournament foil set, when available, went to the winner. These prizes were awarded even if an event was not sanctioned. Any player who won three events of the tour, in any combination of the two games, was to receive a special prize of an uncut sheet or a trophy. A tournament director could play in his or her own event but could not win a prize.<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
